title: Joseph Smith’s Revelations, Doctrine and Covenants 16
book: Joseph Smith's Revelations: A D&C Study Companion from the Joseph Smith Papers

footnotes.text: See Historical Introduction to Revelation, June 1829–C [D&C 15],herein.

The editors of the Book of Commandments composed revelation headings loosely based on John Whitmer’s headings found in Revelation Book 1. Because the page or pages in Revelation Book 1 that apparently contained this revelation are missing, it is unknown whose work is reflected in this heading. Regardless, it was most likely not part of the original revelation text.
A June 1829 revelation instructed Oliver Cowdery and David Whitmer that the twelve were to be identified by “their desires and their works.” (Revelation, June 1829–B [D&C 18:38],herein.)
A prior revelation had addressed the worth of souls in describing the duties given to Oliver Cowdery and David Whitmer. (Revelation, June 1829–B [D&C 18:15–16],herein.)
See Book of Mormon, 1830 ed., 510 [3 Nephi 28:8–10]; and Revelation, June 1829–B [D&C 18:15–16, 25, 44–46],herein.
